task.title: Tech-choice advisory: should we move to Kubernetes now?
task.goal: Recommend whether to adopt K8s based on team size and workload
task.context: Team of 8 · 3 services · 50k MAU · no dedicated SRE

userStory.trigger: The team is torn over whether to move to Kubernetes
userStory.goal: Get a grounded recommendation that spells out its premises
userStory.reads: The agent's recommendation, the assumptions it rests on (and what would flip the conclusion), the key tradeoff, and the points that still need your confirmation
userStory.acts: Adopt the recommendation / dispute an assumption / add your real constraints (compliance, team, traffic)

observablePrimitives.label: Current state: 8 people, 3 services, 50k MAU, no dedicated SRE
Ops-cost reference: managed containers vs. self-hosted K8s

toolCalls.summary: self-hosted K8s carries a high ops burden

nodes.title: Don't go all-in on K8s at this stage; managed containers (e.g. Cloud Run / ECS) + IaC are more cost-effective

evidence.label: no dedicated SRE, limited ops bandwidth
steady traffic, 3 services — not yet in K8s's payoff zone
self-hosted K8s ops cost is markedly higher

nodes.title: Assumption: no dedicated platform team, and no hard elasticity / multi-cloud need
nodes.falsification: If you already have a platform/SRE team, or a hard requirement for bursty elasticity or multi-cloud portability, the recommendation flips — K8s's payoff starts to outweigh its complexity.

nodes.title: K8s buys elasticity and portability at the cost of significant ops and cognitive overhead
nodes.falsification: Once the service count and team grow to where you need fine-grained scheduling / self-healing, the trade starts to pay off; today's scale hasn't hit that inflection.

nodes.title: "The big players all use K8s, so we should too"
nodes.reason: Complexity with no business driver is a liability; tech choices should be set by workload and team capability, not by trend.

nodes.title: Is there a compliance requirement forcing on-prem / a specific deployment shape?
nodes.needs: Confirm whether any hard compliance constraint (data residency or private deployment) applies — it would directly change the managed-vs-self-hosted conclusion.

outcome.label: Recommendation · Grounded
outcome.text: Recommend managed containers + IaC for now, and save K8s for when scale or team reach its payoff zone.
outcome.recommendation: Confirm the compliance constraints first (see "Needs your call" below); revisit if a hard elasticity / multi-cloud need emerges later.

steps.label: Give the recommendation
steps.hint: Give the answer directly, with the supporting evidence attached.

steps.label: Surface the assumptions
steps.hint: Honestly flag the assumptions the recommendation rests on (no SRE, no hard elasticity) rather than hiding them.

steps.label: Tradeoff
steps.hint: Make K8s's tradeoff explicit, and point to when the trade would pay off.

steps.label: Pending confirmation
steps.hint: Leave one open risk: a compliance constraint would change the conclusion.
